title: Astrid and the Gravity
author: W. M. Dunmore
blurb: Orsen Quintana, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
